name: 33317 · Plantation, FL
findings: ZIP 33317 (Plantation) has 175 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33317 (Plantation) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: No social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 7 would.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
